fieldNotes.truckGate: Main S Poinciana Blvd entrance is an ornamental-fenced, landscaped office/visitor drive with no barrier or booth at z20; a second service access comes off the north frontage road at the NW. Neither shows a control structure, but small swing gates would be below resolution — flagged.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed: an active-looking rail siding runs directly along the plant's north wall (visible in 2024-11 Street View from the frontage road), branching from the adjacent CSX corridor; grade-level freight doors face the siding.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bays split across the south face (~15, recessed clusters with staged pallets) and the west face (~10) plus tanker positions at the east production end; 28 estimated.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Almost no parked trailers on site (~10 near the south docks); the big empty concrete yard at the west end is unmarked open pavement (counted as staging, not drop).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: South-face docks vs west-face docks vs rail/tanker receiving at the east end suggest separated flows; inferred from layout only.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Kissimmee/Orlando commercial corridor (US 17-92 x Poinciana Blvd).
